description: Record a compensating control for an in-scope control (write — editor). A material control needs risk_code: an accepted, linked risk with an approval in force (409 otherwise).

effectiveness_rating.description: Effectiveness: full, partial, minimal (platform default partial)

gap_description.description: What the control does not meet (non-blank)

risk_code.description: Accepted risk that justifies compensating: one linked to the control and assessed by the org. Required on a material control, where its approval must be in force

risk_reduction_notes.description: Notes on how the risk is reduced

scf_id.description: Control the gap is in — must be in scope (422 otherwise); obtain from scf_list_scoped_controls

name: scf_create_org_compensating_control
